checks.name: Temperature bands use exact existing boundaries including feels-like
Frozen/freezing and snow weather codes are explicitly mapped
Season uses selected date and hemisphere; no assumed user location
Location is coarsened, bounded, and invalid values rejected
Current model estimate retains provider units, timestamps and source
Future date uses clearly labelled daily forecast high, not fake current or noon reading
Out-of-range dates, Celsius and missing values are rejected
Automatic request refuses stale time/date and preserves original state
Initialization is read-only with no implicit location/network request
Weather saves/reloads in its own key without touching wear or Favorites
Corrupt and stale-tab weather data is not silently overwritten
Search lists all returned cities without automatically selecting one
Forecast uses allowed host, Fahrenheit, rounded coordinates and no credentials
Location permission denial leaves prior settings intact and exposes manual fallback
Location success fetches but does not apply until explicit confirmation
Network/HTTP/malformed/aborted requests preserve previous manual settings
Unknown material is not filled with guessed fibre or sole properties
Weather effects are separate from wardrobe compatibility and demonstrably operational
Explicit recorded seasonal eligibility does not alter catalogue metadata
Texture resemblance is not promoted to known cloth composition
Suede elbow patches do not turn a herringbone blazer into an all-suede garment
